captures.description: VRONIPLAG WIKI, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a crowdsourced online platform hosted on Fandom that investigates and documents academic plagiarism in German doctoral dissertations, habilitations, and scientific publications.' Launch (28 March 2011), name (after Veronica Saß, daughter of Edmund Stoiber, the first case documented), scope (percentages of copied text, side-by-side comparisons, revocations), process (findings reported to the university's office of academic integrity before public release), recognition (the Zedler-Preis of Wikimedia Germany, 2012). Three cards: English Wikipedia, the wiki's home on Fandom, its Übersicht page ('Es dokumentiert 204 Disse…').
